overview: This single-page file consists of a Department of State list-of-papers entry recording an April 21, 1933 despatch from Ketchum at Taihoku concerning mineral production in Taiwan during 1931. The referenced despatch, numbered 59, evidently transmitted or completed a Bureau of Mines questionnaire, but the substantive report itself is not present on this page.

people.name: Ketchum
people.role: Official at the U.S. post in Taihoku and author of despatch no. 59

subfiles.title: List-of-papers entry for Taihoku despatch no. 59 on Taiwan mineral production
subfiles.from: Department of State, recording a despatch from Ketchum at Taihoku
subfiles.about: The entry identifies a consular despatch reporting Taiwan's mineral production for 1931 in response to a Bureau of Mines questionnaire.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State filing entry records despatch no. 59 from Ketchum at Taihoku, dated April 21, 1933. The despatch concerned mineral production in Taiwan during 1931 and supplied information requested through a Bureau of Mines questionnaire. The underlying despatch and its statistical contents are not included here.

interest: Although only an index entry, the page provides a useful archival pointer to a potentially detailed statistical report on mining in Japanese-ruled Taiwan. It also documents the U.S. consular network's role in collecting economic intelligence for the Bureau of Mines and supplies the date, post, author surname, and despatch number needed to locate the missing report.
